description: Bornes IRVE Syndicat Intercommunal d'Electricité et de Gaz de l'Eure is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Intercommunal de l'Electricite et du GaZ de l'Eure. Table containing the public access charging points of SIEGE 27: Union Intercommunal of Electricity and Gas of Eure. Coverage: Syndicat Intercommunal de l'Electricite et du GaZ de l'Eure. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE Terminals Intercommunal Union of Electricity and Gas of Eure" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Intercommunal de l'Electricite et du GaZ de l'Eure. Its keywords include bornes-de-recharge, eure, bornes-electrique, irve. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
